options.text: A reaction where two compounds combine to form a new compound
A reaction where a more reactive element takes the place of a less reactive element in a compound
A reaction where a compound breaks down into its elements
A reaction where two elements swap places in a compound

questions.explanation: A displacement reaction occurs when a more reactive element takes the place of a less reactive element in a compound. For example, zinc (more reactive) can displace copper (less reactive) from copper sulfate solution.
